title: Google Marketing Tools Support & Customer Service - Google Ads

facts.fact: Google Ads is a pay-per-click advertising platform, meaning advertisers pay only when someone clicks on their ad.
facts.quote: Google Ads is a pay-per-click advertising platform, meaning that you only pay when someone clicks on your ad.

facts.fact: The page states that Google Ads cost depends on industry, target audience, and chosen keywords, and it does not give a specific price.
facts.quote: The cost of your ads will depend on a number of factors, including your industry, your target audience, and the keywords you choose.

facts.fact: Multiple campaigns can be created within the same Google Ads account without creating a new account.
facts.quote: You can create multiple campaigns in the same account without creating a new account.

facts.fact: Setting up a Google Ads account requires a Google Ads account, a budget, and a website, along with choosing campaign goals, ad type, and keywords.
facts.quote: To get started with Google Ads, you’ll need a Google Ads account, a budget, and a website.

facts.fact: During Google Ads account setup, the advertiser enters business information such as the website URL, chooses campaign goals, uploads creative assets, sets a budget, and enters a payment method.
facts.quote: enter your business information like your website URL. After that, choose your campaign goals, upload your creative assets and set your budget. Finally, enter your payment method.

facts.fact: Google Ads is Google's online advertising program used to promote a business, sell products or services, raise brand awareness, and increase website traffic.
facts.quote: Google Ads is Google’s online advertising program.
